notes.title: [Store page published] Add Cross
notes.content:
On September 5, 2025, we launched the store page for a game called "Add Cross." 

Write the numbers 1 through 9 one by one without repeating them, and add them all up to get the number in the puzzle square! This is a quick and easy pencil puzzle game.

notes.title: Sharing information about SteamDeck compatibility.
notes.content:
This game was developed to be playable comfortably with Steam Deck. We hope to pass the Steam Deck compatibility check.

If you have played this game with Steam Deck, please post your impressions in this article. Your comments will be used as reference for the Steam Deck compatibility review.

Thank you.

notes.title: RucKyGAMES' New Game Release "Ruku's Heart Balloon"
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Sudoku Classic.
 
 On November 11, RucKyGAMES released a puzzle game called "Ruku's Heart Balloon".
 Like Sudoku Classic, it is a puzzle game made by thinking out a pleasant operation feeling.
 I'm glad you can play if you like.

[b]* "What is "Ruku's Heart Balloon"[/b]
This puzzle game can be enjoyed by players of all ages.
The gentle story is straight out of a picture book with voices,
like telling a story to a child.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337290/_/

[b]* 7 languages![/b]
In Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese
You can enjoy a story like a gentle picture book!
